label: PF Backlog 693
title: Context & Knowledge Router: query intent classification, retrieval mode selection, and budget routing
body:
## Problem / why
Agents query knowledge monolithically or rely on full context dumps without understanding query intent or retrieval cost.

## Goal & value
Build the Context/Knowledge Router that analyzes incoming agent queries and dynamically routes between prompt context, CAG cache, vector RAG, keyword BM25, and knowledge graphs.

## Reference Documents
- `docs/Product_Forge_RAG_CAG_Knowledge_Fabric_Integration.md#section-14`

## In scope
- Intent classifier for factual, architectural, operational, and code-pattern queries.
- Dynamic mode selector: Prompt vs CAG vs Vector RAG vs Graph vs Keyword.
- Fallback degradation: fallback to lexical or working memory if vector/graph services are unreachable.
- Telemetry on query routing decisions and retrieval latencies.

## Out of scope
- Heavy ML classifiers requiring dedicated GPU inference.

## Definition of Done
- Unit and integration tests verify deterministic routing decisions.

## Verification
Structured `acceptance_criteria` is the single source of truth for verification.

acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Router classifies query intent into factual, architectural, past_decision, procedural, or trace categories.
AC-2: Routes to the optimal retrieval substrate with configurable routing policies per pipeline stage.
AC-3: Automatically degrades to lexical search or working prompt memory if vector service is offline.
AC-4: Routing latency overhead is under 5ms for local operations.
